messages:
emma: hi team — new signup (email: claire@eu-corp.co) completed email verify ~10m ago but welcome credits didn't appear. Account id: `acct_987654`. Region shows EU in profile. Signed up with Apple Pay (virtual card). Can someone check autogrant?
ajay: thanks emma — can you paste the signup flow link or screenshot of the account page? any payment txn id?
emma: attaching screenshot in thread (redacted). Payment method shows Apple Pay • virtual card • last4 4242. No txn id on profile.
payments-bot: payment-intent not found for acct_987654, 3DS status: PASSED (gateway callback at 2060012320, payment recorded with token `pi_tok_33f`).
ajay: weird — autogrant should be triggered after email verify OR after successful payment for some flows. I'll check the grant logs.
billing_ops: I see autogrant job run at 2060012300 for that email domain (eu-corp.co) and it returned: `skipped: flagged_domain=enterprise`. There's also a payment reconciliation entry showing a BIN-country mismatch flagged for virtual card.
emma: customer insists they used a personal account, not company purchase. domain is personal domain but our heuristics flagged it due to our enterprise allowlist?
billing_ops: looks like the domain matched our enterprise list snapshot (old entry). We treat enterprise domains as ineligible for free trial by default, which is why autogrant skipped. Also there's a race: 3DS callback arrived slightly after account creation so the fallback payment-based autogrant didn't fire.
devex: reproducible steps request: 1) sign up with email on enterprise-like domain 2) add Apple Pay virtual card 3) complete 3DS slightly delayed (simulate slow gateway), 4) verify email. If autogrant logic checks domain first and bails, payment-based path never runs.
eng-oncall: confirmed. I can reproduce locally by delaying the webhook. Root cause: autogrant job short-circuits on domain flag without scheduling a follow-up check when payment status arrives later.
ajay: can we do a manual grant for `acct_987654` now? customer is blocked from experimenting.
billing_ops: running manual grant: `/grant-welcome acct_987654 --source support --reason "manual grant after false enterprise flag + late 3DS"`
billing_ops: done — credits +$50 applied, txn `grant_2026_549`. Please verify. :white_check_mark: 
emma: customer confirmed credits visible in console and can create keys. Thanks!
eng-oncall: small fix queued: change autogrant flow to schedule a 30s recheck when payment status is pending/late callback. Will open PR and target patch release today.
devex: leaving repro notes in /kb/ on the support docs and adding a troubleshooting checklist: check domain list, check payment webhook timestamps, run `/grant-welcome` if customer needs immediate access.
ajay: creating followup ticket: https://internal.atlassian.redwood/RED-4219 — will track rollout and postmortem.
emma: closing loop with customer and leaving a short apology. Good catch everyone.
eng-oncall: adding monitoring alert to autogrant-skip-rate for enterprise-flagged accounts so we don't miss regressions.
payments-bot: gateway latency spike detected 2060012280-2060012360 (stripe-eu), impact 0.6% auth callbacks delayed.
ajay: thanks — marking resolved for this thread, reach out if any more weird cases crop up.
